title: The Static of the Kuiper Line
author: Coral Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Ishikawa, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
